💡 This review uniquely bridges material-level properties with system-level constraints in lithium–oxygen batteries, addressing oxygen management in open and closed architectures. Journal of Materials Chemistry A | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty lies in designing a single-source precursor for phase-pure SnS2 and engineering a built-in electric field in SnS2/expanded graphite anodes. This enables high-rate lithium storage, addressing the slow kinetics and instability of tin-based anodes. The work offers a greener, controlled synthesis route and demonstrates a viable strategy for high-performance anode design.

💡 Rufigallol-based 2D MOF nanosheets are introduced as bifunctional cathode catalysts for rechargeable Zn–air batteries.
